notes: Evals 1-3 are regression evals derived from three manual test cycles. Eval 4 is a designed isolation eval for the goal-alignment anchor. Fixtures live in evals/fixtures/ and carry intentional, planted drift; do not clean them. The skill is disable-model-invocation, so these test output behaviour, not triggering.

evals.prompt: /qualifying-outputs evals/fixtures/cache-requirements.md — run the full cycle, one anchor per pass, to convergence. The originating decision record is the block at the top of the file, the governing contract is the writing-requirements skill, and the session goal is a requirements doc for the session cache scoped to what the team actually settled, so planning can build from it.
evals.expected_output: A per-anchor cycle that lays a drift table each pass, applies nothing before arbitration, catches the planted decision and contract drifts, runs goal alignment last with no residual left to catch, and declares convergence on five anchors.
assertions: R3 (retain 7 days) is flagged Impactful on decision fidelity as a deferral recorded as a decision
R4 (at most 1000) is flagged Impactful as an unconfirmed number recorded as decided
R6 (30 days for audit) is flagged Impactful as a fabricated decision
The 'ship the read path first' line under Key decisions is flagged Impactful as a recommendation, not a decision
R5 (reasonably fast) is flagged Impactful on the governing-contract anchor as not testable
No fix is applied before the accept/reject step; the first pass output is a drift table only

The goal-alignment anchor runs last and surfaces zero Impactful residual drifts, because the per-claim drifts (R3, R4, R6, the Key-decisions line) were already filed under decision fidelity, not re-filed here
The cycle declares convergence once all five anchors are clean on the same version

evals.prompt: /qualifying-outputs evals/fixtures/onboarding-proposal.md — run the full cycle. There is no separate decision record for this proposal and no session goal is stated.
evals.expected_output: A cycle that declares the governing-contract anchor degraded, the decision-fidelity and goal-alignment anchors unverifiable, catches the consistency and conventions drifts, and refuses to declare convergence.
assertions: The governing-contract anchor is declared degraded (no owning template or checklist)
The decision-fidelity anchor is declared unverifiable because no originating record is available, not clean-by-default
The goal-alignment anchor is declared unverifiable because no session goal is recoverable or stated, not clean-by-default
The cycle does NOT declare convergence, and says the unverifiable anchors (decision fidelity and goal alignment) block it until the record and the goal are supplied
The Approach-versus-Timeline day-two-versus-single-day contradiction is flagged Impactful on internal consistency
The bracketed 'e.g.' in the Tooling section is flagged Impactful on conventions
The inline bold and the filler words (robust, harnesses, to ensure) are flagged Impactful on conventions

evals.prompt: Here is a recommendation I just wrote: 'We should adopt trunk-based development, the team already agreed, and we will cut releases every Friday.' Ground truth from our chat: the team discussed trunk-based development but did not agree, and no release cadence was decided. Run a qualify pass over that recommendation, decision fidelity first.
evals.expected_output: A chat-modality pass that audits the pasted recommendation, applies fixes by restating inline with no Edit or version bump, and rotates one anchor per pass.
assertions: The skill operates in chat modality: no file is read or edited, fixes are applied by restating the corrected text inline
'the team already agreed' is flagged Impactful on decision fidelity, since the team did not agree
'releases every Friday' is flagged Impactful, since no cadence was decided
The governing-contract anchor is declared degraded for a chat answer
Only one anchor is audited in the first pass (decision fidelity), not all five at once
No version bump or commit is claimed

evals.prompt: /qualifying-outputs evals/fixtures/search-index-runbook.md — run the full cycle to convergence. The session goal and the originating decision record are the two ground-truth blocks at the top of the file. There is no owning template for the runbook.
evals.expected_output: A cycle where decision fidelity, internal consistency, and conventions come up clean, governing contract is declared degraded, and the goal-alignment anchor (running last) is the only one to surface Impactful drift: an off-goal section and a goal-required omission.
assertions: The decision-fidelity anchor comes up clean: every section present (migration steps, paging, launch announcement) traces to a recorded decision
The governing-contract anchor is declared degraded (no owning template or checklist for the runbook)
The internal-consistency and conventions anchors come up clean
The goal-alignment anchor flags the 'Launch announcement' section as Impactful scope creep: it traces to a real decision but sits outside the session goal of an on-call migration-and-rollback runbook

The goal-alignment anchor flags the missing rollback path as a Impactful omission: the session goal requires it and the rollback was decided, yet no runbook section states it, and no earlier anchor tests for absence
Goal alignment runs last in the rotation, after the four earlier anchors
No fix is applied before the accept/reject step
The cycle does not declare convergence until the goal-alignment drifts are arbitrated and the anchor is clean on the same version
